question: Where can I get a list of public electric vehicle charging points in the United States, with location, operator, power (kW) and number of connectors?

answer.summary: The DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center (AFDC) Station Locator is the national official list. Its API (developer.nlr.gov) gives, per station location, coordinates, access, status, charging network and ports by level, and per charging unit the connector types, port counts and kW. On 2026-11-26 it held 84,725 public operating station locations with 267,448 charging ports (station_counts), plus 220 planned. 'Operator' is the network/provider field, not a separate CPO name, and kW is missing for part of Level 2 ports.
main_caveats: Count units differ: AFDC 'station' = location; station_counts.total and state tables for electric count charging ports; connector entries can exceed ports.
API defaults include private, planned and temporarily unavailable stations; filter access=public&status=E (planned = status=P with expected_date).
Operator is the charging network/provider (ev_network), not a CPO name; AFDC lists 17,948 Non-Networked ports (US and Canada) with no operator name.
California's CEC reports 98,251 public ports (data as of 2026-06-30, adds PlugShare and surveys) vs 70,178 in AFDC for CA on 2026-11-26: different sources, not equivalent.
The legacy developer.nrel.gov API host no longer resolves; use developer.nlr.gov. DEMO_KEY is rate-limited; the CSV form asks for name and email.
answer.confidence_reason: AFDC API, docs and counts pages were opened and tested on 2026-11-26 with a full Connecticut extract and a 97% national ports CSV read; operator limitation confirmed in field lists.

attributes.note: Lat/lon per station location with geocode_status accuracy; in CT 1,431 of 1,665 GPS, all inside the state bbox.
ev_network names the charging network per station and per charging unit; Non-Networked stations have none.
attributes.gap_note: No charge point operator (CPO) name field in the AFDC API/CSV field lists; 23 CFR 680.116(c) requires operator name only in per-network APIs for federally funded chargers.

attributes.note: power_kw per connector type within each charging unit (port level). DC fast filled; Level 2 often null.
attributes.gap_note: Nulls in source: CT 931 of 5,356 connector entries without kW; nationally 17,842 of 260,156 port rows read had no kW.

attributes.note: port_count per connector type per charging unit plus ports per level per station; unit is EVSE port, a port may list several connector types.

inclusion_rule.value: Networked stations imported from charging networks (daily API or periodic CSV); non-networked stations added manually. Public vs private via access_code; residential chargers are not included.
inclusion_rule.quote: For non-networked EV charging stations, the data collection team adds stations to the Station Locator manually as they are identified and verifies the stations every other year.

reference_date.value: Live database; last-updated endpoint returned 2026-11-26T06:17:47Z on 2026-11-26. Per-record date_last_confirmed and updated_at.
reference_date.quote: date_last_confirmed Type: date The date the station's details were last confirmed.

update_frequency.value: Daily for networks with API import; periodic for CSV networks; every other year verification for non-networked stations.
update_frequency.quote: For charging networks with an application programming interface (API), the Station Locator imports data from a direct connection daily.

exclusions.value: Residential charging is excluded; private stations are in the data but flagged access_code=private.
exclusions.quote: Includes legacy chargers but does not include residential electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

key_fields.meaning: Station coordinates and their accuracy class (GPS, 200-8 address, 200-5 postal code, etc.).
E available, P planned, T temporarily unavailable; expected_date for P/T.
Charging network (network service provider) or Non-Networked; not a separate charge point operator field.
Number of EVSE ports per charging level at the station.
Power output in kW and number of ports per connector type within each charging unit.
Owner type (P, LG, SG, FG, J, T) and host facility type; often empty.
Last confirmation date and last update timestamp per station.

how_to_use.example_result: total_results 1665; station_counts ELEC total 4971 (ports). Record id 102092 'Danbury, CT - Tesla Supercharger', 7 Backus Ave, 41.379456,-73.4779, geocode 200-8, ev_network Tesla, ev_dc_fast_num 10; charging unit: TESLA power_kw 150.0 port_count 1.
steps: Use https://developer.nlr.gov (the former developer.nrel.gov host did not resolve on 2026-11-26).
Always pass fuel_type=ELEC, country=US, access=public and status=E for operating public stations; query status=P separately for planned stations.
Page by state (limit=all) or use the /v1/ev-charging-units.csv endpoint for one row per charging unit with connector counts and kW per connector family.
Flatten ev_charging_units: each unit has charging_level, port_count and a connectors record keyed by type with power_kw and port_count.
For historical snapshots since 2014 or a full CSV use the AFDC data download form (requires name and email).
reading_traps: API defaults are status=all and access=all: without filters planned, temporarily unavailable and private stations are mixed in.
station_counts.total for ELEC counts charging ports, not stations; station_counts.stations.total counts station locations.
ev_network is the network/software provider; AFDC defines station operator (CPO) separately but has no CPO name field. Non-Networked stations carry no operator name.
Connector entries can exceed ports: in CT 5,356 connector entries with ports vs 4,971 ports (a port may offer more than one connector type).
power_kw is often null for Level 2: in CT 3,446 of 4,373 Level 2 connector-ports had kW vs 976 of 976 DC fast.
The ports CSV only has J1772, CCS, CHAdeMO, J3400 and J3271 connector columns; NEMA outlets are not broken out.
Planned records can be stale: e.g. id 63615 status P with expected_date 2023-07-01 and date_last_confirmed 2023-05-03.
DEMO_KEY returned X-RateLimit-Limit 10 although the docs state 30 per hour and 50 per day; full use needs a free key.
owner_type_code empty for 970 and facility_type empty for 967 of 1,665 CT stations.

problems: Legacy host developer.nrel.gov does not resolve; the API answers at developer.nlr.gov.
DEMO_KEY rate limit observed at 10 requests (X-RateLimit-Limit: 10); a personal key requires signup.
The web CSV download form asks for first name, last name and email.
Nationwide ev-charging-units.csv exceeds 100 MB; only the first 100,000,000 bytes were read (260,156 port rows of 82,376 stations).

regulator.name: No single regulator of all public charging; FHWA sets minimum standards for federally funded chargers (23 CFR 680); DOE AFDC collects the national station data.

operators.note: Over 100 charging networks plus Non-Networked stations are listed by AFDC with last import dates and port counts (e.g. ChargePoint 93,684, Tesla Supercharger 44,200, Blink 22,351 ports; US and Canada).

publication_obligation.norm: 23 CFR 680.116(c) (applies to chargers funded under Title 23 programs such as NEVI); California state law cited by CEC requires reporting to the national lab.
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Free API for third-party developers with station id, address, exact coordinates, operator name, network provider name, status, access, number of ports, connector types, charging level and kW per port, real-time status and price.
publication_obligation.frequency: Real-time status/price per OCPI 2.2.1 terms; static-field frequency not stated in the rule text read.

consolidated_republication.note: AFDC imports networks' data (daily API via OCPI or periodic CSV) and republishes it nationally, but not the operator name or real-time port data required by 680.116(c).
